notes:
Details side panel: click a person, group or Chromebook in any table and their status, main actions and details slide in from the right. Esc closes it, and double-click still opens the full page. Pages that already react to a row click (such as Groups) keep their own behaviour.
Tab overflow: when a page’s tabs don’t fit, a More ▾ button lists them all. Users needed this.
Pop-up windows: confirmations and messages are now rounded cards with a clear title and buttons, and risky actions like suspend, delete or wipe get a red button.
Loading placeholders: while a list loads you’ll see grey shimmering rows, or a thin moving line along the top if the table already has rows.
Shorter sidebar: pages in My pages aren’t listed again below, and sections other than the one you’re in fold automatically. Right-click the sidebar to turn either off.
Emoji removed: the remaining emoji are now line icons or plain text. Once tips are hidden, a small Tips link appears next to each page title. Clicking the top search box now opens the Ctrl+K window.
Narrower forms: single-line fields stop at about 720 pixels on wide screens.
Ticket chip: the ticket box is now a ticket icon in the top bar. Click it to paste a ticket link or number; it then shows “#1234”.
Customize Home in place: each box gets a small bar so you can drag it, nudge it with ↑ ↓ or remove it with ✕. There’s also Add a box, More options… for quick actions, tiles and links, and Done.
Empty states: an empty table says why: nothing loaded yet, no results, or nothing matches the filter (with a Clear filter button).
Back button: at the top left, or Alt+Left, or your mouse’s back button.
Table density and columns: a list button at the end of each table’s toolbar switches between compact and comfortable rows. Columns… lets you hide and reorder columns, saved per page, and you can also drag column headings.

Settings & Updates → Appearance has new switches for the details panel, pop-ups and row density.
